name: BUSN 3003W
title: Business Communications
description: Techniques for improving professional writing and oral communications skills and ways in which visual communications, document design, and use of workplace technologies shape the message.
requirement_description: ENGL 1007 or 1010 or 1011; Open only to Business majors of sophomore or higher status. Not open for credit to students who have passed BUSN 3002W or 3004W, or BADM 4075W or MENT 3070W.
